description: TG WS Proxy (Flowseal): local MTProto proxy for Telegram Desktop that carries its traffic over WebSocket (and Cloudflare) to Telegram's servers, which helps where Telegram is slowed down or blocked. Tray app with a settings window.
notes: Scoop Apps: 'TG WS Proxy' starts it in the tray. Right-click the tray icon, 'Open in Telegram' sets up
Telegram Desktop (or add an MTProto proxy 127.0.0.1:1443 with the secret from Settings by hand).
Settings, secret and log are kept in %USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\TG-WS-Proxy\TgWsProxy_data (portable mode).
A first start moves an existing %APPDATA%\TgWsProxy there.
Its own update check is off in a new config, because Scoop updates it ('scoop update TG-WS-Proxy').
Start with Windows (Settings) runs ...\apps\TG-WS-Proxy\current\TgWsProxy.exe, so it survives updates.
x64 and ARM64 builds need Windows 10 or newer; 32-bit Windows gets upstream's Windows 7 build.
pre_install: # A copy running anywhere else holds port 1443 and its data folder (scripts/common/Test-AppBusy.ps1).
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { error "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$($busyCheck -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')' is missing."; break }

if ($busy) { error "$app is running. Exit it from its tray menu, then install again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")`nScoop has already put $app into its app folder: run 'scoop uninstall $app' or simply install again, which cleans that up."; break }
# TgWsProxy_data next to the exe turns on portable mode. A new config only turns off the self-update check;
# the proxy fills in the rest (port, secret...) and saves it on its first start.
pre_uninstall: # Scoop only sees a copy that runs from its own folder; the tray app keeps its data files open.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { warn "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$($busyCheck -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')' is missing."; return }
if ($busy) { error "$app is running. Exit it from its tray menu and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }

script: # 'Start with Windows' leaves a Run entry pointing into the app folder; remove it with the app.
